content.text: I’m writing it now... when did you send that text to the guys?
I just responded to McCosky after I texted you
And then a couple others reached out
No your teammates
About missing them and taking things seriously
Ohhhhh. That was a couple nights ago
When did you initially test postitive
The 23rd
Ok just sent you something at dnorrisjkl18@gmail.com
Give it a quick look when you get a min
Okay on it
Liked “Okay on it”
Half way through. Just one thing so far is I’m in Detroit. Not Tampa
Ok
Just finished. Looks good
Cool. Thanks for talking yesterday. Get those negatives now
Of course!
Also if you want me to send you the actual text I sent the guys I can do that
Yeah that would work

Yo Just wanted to drop in and say a couple things. 1. I miss y’all like crazy. I wish I was out there prepping for a monster year with the crew -Miss all the clubhouse hangs at cafe Noriega. (Might have to turn it into a secret society speakeasy this year) 2. I hope everyone is taking the protocols seriously. For 1 reason, the virus is no joke. It’s heavy.. but for another, the process of getting back on the field feels borderline impossible. - For us to be successful we need everyone on that diamond so just be smart; go above and beyond is all I’m saying. I thought I was doing enough to stay safe but apparently not. / can’t wait to get back out there Stay stoked mi hermanos. 🙏 ⚡️
